Questions.content: Why is "TotalTimeCalculation" included in the TG if it's already given that the shore is 64 seconds away? This task seems unnecessary and can be removed.

Why is "DistanceTravelledCalculation" included in the TG since the distance to the shore is given as 64 seconds, and assuming a constant speed, we can calculate the distance directly without needing a separate task? This task seems unnecessary and can be removed.
Why is "WaterInflowRateCalculation" included as a separate task when the inflow rate is given directly in the problem statement (2 liters per 10 feet)? This task seems unnecessary and can be removed.
